name: finspace-data
description: The FinSpace APIs let you take actions inside the FinSpace.

subcommands.name: associate-user-to-permission-group
subcommands.description: Adds a user to a permission group to grant permissions for actions a user can perform in FinSpace.

subcommands.name: create-changeset
subcommands.description: Creates a new Changeset in a FinSpace Dataset.

subcommands.name: create-data-view
subcommands.description: Creates a Dataview for a Dataset.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates a new FinSpace Dataset.

subcommands.name: create-permission-group
subcommands.description: Creates a group of permissions for various actions that a user can perform in FinSpace.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a new user in FinSpace.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset
subcommands.description: Deletes a FinSpace Dataset.

subcommands.name: delete-permission-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a permission group.

subcommands.name: disable-user
subcommands.description: Denies access to the FinSpace web application and API for the specified user.

subcommands.name: disassociate-user-from-permission-group
subcommands.description: Removes a user from a permission group.

subcommands.name: enable-user
subcommands.description: Allows the specified user to access the FinSpace web application and API.

subcommands.name: get-changeset
subcommands.description: Get information about a Changeset.

subcommands.name: get-data-view
subcommands.description: Gets information about a Dataview.

subcommands.name: get-dataset
subcommands.description: Returns information about a Dataset.

subcommands.name: get-external-data-view-access-details
subcommands.description: Returns the credentials to access the external Dataview from an S3 location.

subcommands.name: get-permission-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific permission group.

subcommands.name: get-programmatic-access-credentials
subcommands.description: Request programmatic credentials to use with FinSpace SDK.

subcommands.name: get-user
subcommands.description: Retrieves details for a specific user.

subcommands.name: get-working-location
subcommands.description: A temporary Amazon S3 location, where you can copy your files from a source location to stage or use as a scratch space in FinSpace notebook.

subcommands.name: list-changesets
subcommands.description: Lists the FinSpace Changesets for a Dataset.

subcommands.name: list-data-views
subcommands.description: Lists all available Dataviews for a Dataset.

subcommands.name: list-datasets
subcommands.description: Lists all of the active Datasets that a user has access to.

subcommands.name: list-permission-groups
subcommands.description: Lists all available permission groups in FinSpace.

subcommands.name: list-permission-groups-by-user
subcommands.description: Lists all the permission groups that are associated with a specific user.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Lists all available users in FinSpace.

subcommands.name: list-users-by-permission-group
subcommands.description: Lists details of all the users in a specific permission group.

subcommands.name: reset-user-password
subcommands.description: Resets the password for a specified user ID and generates a temporary one.

subcommands.name: update-changeset
subcommands.description: Updates a FinSpace Changeset.

subcommands.name: update-dataset
subcommands.description: Updates a FinSpace Dataset.

subcommands.name: update-permission-group
subcommands.description: Modifies the details of a permission group.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Modifies the details of the specified user.
